title: Map page: Graph and River views
description:
Build the Graph view: a concept graph centred on a selectable node, with relation line styles and the side panel.

Build the River view: clusters over weeks with the time scrubber.

With 1 week of history, show the honest cold-start state ("nothing to replay yet"). The 26-week sample stays a tagged placeholder until the weekly history exists (Reposition 3).

Acceptance: the graph reads real relations from the knowledge snapshot, and the river shows real weeks only.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done and live: #66. The Graph view uses real relations. The River shows the honest cold start; the 26-week history fills as weekly archives accumulate (ship-09ea2c).
